shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- app/page.tsx ---\\n' && cat app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- app/product/page.tsx ---\\n' && cat app/product/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- lib/data.ts ---\\n' && cat lib/data.ts && printf '\\n--- app/layout.tsx ---\\n' && cat app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- git status ---\\n' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -c "ls -la __agent_eval__ && git log -4 --oneline && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" && rg -n 'partialPrefetching|prefetch =|getRelatedProducts' app lib next.config.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -65"

/bin/bash -c 'for path in docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.mdx docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/prefetch.mdx docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-file-conventions/01-route-segment-config/prefetch.mdx; do echo "--- $path"; curl -sSL --max-time 8 "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel/next.js/canary/$path" | head -140; done; printf '"'\\n--- local prefetch types ---\\n'; rg -n 'prefetch\\(|prefetch:|prefetch\\?:|prefetch =|partialPrefetching' node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/unstable-cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache | head -65"

/bin/bash -c "curl -fsSL --max-time 12 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel/next.js/canary/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.mdx | sed -n '100,290p'; echo '\\n--- next/cache package exports ---'; cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts | head -110; echo '\\n--- API declaration ---'; rg -n 'unstable_prefetch' node_modules/next/cache.js node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension | head -25"

/bin/bash -c "curl -fsSL --max-time 12 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel/next.js/canary/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.mdx | sed -n '/## Exclude content from a prefetch/,/## How "'`unstable_prefetch()` differs/p'"'; echo '\\n--- local implementation of unstable_prefetch ---'; sed -n '1,210p' node_modules/next/dist/server/request/cache-stages.js; echo '\\n--- eval file details ---'; head -65 __agent_eval__/run.mjs"

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && rg -n -o 'Compact Widget|Loading related products|prefetch' .next/server/app/product.html .next/server/app/product.rsc .next/server/app/index.html .next/server/app/index.rsc 2>/dev/null | head -70 && cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -c "find .next/server/app -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*product*' -o -name '*prefetch*' | sort | head -50; ls -la .next/server/app | head -40; cat .gitignore && git show HEAD:tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -c "find .next/server/app/product.segments -type f -maxdepth 3 -printf '%p %s bytes\\n'; cat .next/server/app/product.meta; echo; for file in .next/server/app/product.segments/*; do echo \""'$(basename "$file") related=$(rg -o '"'Compact Widget' \""'$file" | wc -l) fallback=$(rg -o '"'Loading related products' \""'$file" | wc -l)"; done'

/bin/bash -c 'for kind in default full; do if [ "$kind" = default ]; then opts=(-H '"'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /product/__PAGE__'); else opts=(-H 'RSC: 1'); fi; curl -sS -D \"/tmp/product-"'${kind}.headers" "${opts[@]}" -o "/tmp/product-${kind}.body" http://localhost:34323/product; printf '"'%s: body bytes=%s related=%s fallback=%s\\n' \""'$kind" "$(wc -c </tmp/product-${kind}.body)" "$(rg -o '"'Compact Widget' /tmp/product-"'${kind}.body | wc -l)" "$(rg -o '"'Loading related products' /tmp/product-"'${kind}.body | wc -l)"; head -16 "/tmp/product-${kind}.headers"; done'

/bin/bash -c 'for kind in default full; do if [ "$kind" = default ]; then opts=(-H '"'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /product/__PAGE__'); else opts=(-H 'RSC: 1'); fi; curl -L -sS -D \"/tmp/product-"'${kind}.headers" "${opts[@]}" -o "/tmp/product-${kind}.body" http://localhost:34323/product; printf '"'%s: body bytes=%s related=%s fallback=%s\\n' \""'$kind" "$(wc -c </tmp/product-${kind}.body)" "$(rg -o '"'Compact Widget' /tmp/product-"'${kind}.body | wc -l)" "$(rg -o '"'Loading related products' /tmp/product-"'${kind}.body | wc -l)"; rg -i '"'HTTP/|x-nextjs|x-matched-path|content-type|cache-control|location' \"/tmp/product-"'${kind}.headers"; done'

/bin/bash -c "for headers in '-H RSC:1 -H Next-Router-Prefetch:1' '-H RSC:1 -H Next-Router-Prefetch:1 -H Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch:/_tree' '-H RSC:1 -H Next-Router-Prefetch:1 -H Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch:/_full'; do echo \"--- "'$headers"; curl -L -sS -H '"'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' "'${headers#*Next-Router-Prefetch:1} -o /tmp/product-prefetch-test http://localhost:34323/product || true; printf '"'bytes=%s related=%s fallback=%s\\n' \""'$(wc -c </tmp/product-prefetch-test)" "$(rg -o '"'Compact Widget' /tmp/product-prefetch-test | wc -l)\" \""'$(rg -o '"'Loading related products' /tmp/product-prefetch-test | wc -l)\"; done"

/bin/bash -c "command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome || :; ls node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer'; rg -n 'prefetchHints|PREFETCH_HINT|unstable_prefetch' node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render | head -24"

/bin/bash -c "node -e 'const fs = require(\"node:fs\"); for (const path of [\".next\", \"next-env.d.ts\", \"tsconfig.tsbuildinfo\"]) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })' && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && nl -ba app/product/page.tsx | sed -n '1,50p' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,20p' && nl -ba next.config.ts | sed -n '1,20p'"
